statement: The circulant Hadamard and Barker-sequence conjectures. Proves that real circulant Hadamard matrices exist exactly in orders 1 and 4, resolving the circulant Hadamard conjecture. Together with classical Barker-sequence results, this shows that binary sequences whose nontrivial aperiodic autocorrelations have magnitude at most 1 exist at lengths n > 1 exactly when $`n\in\{2,3,4,5,7,11,13\}`$.
